posts.title: Predicting UAV zone entry: matching the data before adding more motion
posts.summary: More varied synthetic motion did not reliably improve predictions on real UAV flights. Matching the generator to AMOVFLY calibration data cut GRU error from 51 to 14 seconds on held-out dates, while the MLP stayed near 16 seconds.

posts.title: What limits a drone swarm's view? From static placement to flight
posts.summary: Across twelve corridor and corner maps, target distance, sensor direction, and drone count had the largest effects on static observation quality. Flight added new losses: four of 108 episodes violated safety constraints.

posts.title: BrowserLens: finding where a browser agent stopped making progress
posts.summary: A complete browser-agent log can still make failures hard to explain. Our UIST 2026 poster submission introduces a graph for spotting repeated states and checking the evidence behind them, with evaluation still to come.

posts.title: Reducing browser-agent tokens: what helped, what added work
posts.summary: Across 20 paired tasks, adaptive page disclosure added work without a measurable benefit. Removing per-link URL attributes cut token use by about 22%. Evaluator fixes and a context audit changed how I understood the results.

posts.title: Why I keep research notes
posts.summary: Notes from rebuilding AI systems, testing ideas, and working through experiments: what worked, what failed, and what to try next.
